reportScope: Original two-hour quantitative soak on iOS Simulator
scopeNotes: Synthetic owner/TV audio and silence at10x; energy VAD, scripted ASR, controlled speaker scores and a local fake realtime server.
Actual capture hub, verification gate, turn orchestrator, persistence, topic segmentation, memory indexing and session rollover run in the app.
This report proves the accelerated simulator checks, not the weekly physical-phone real-model soak.
Both quantitative and leak-profiled sessions passed all eight original checks; six leak readings have zero growth. The physical-device weekly run remains pending.
